page.layout: One column of running text, with a marginal note in the left margin beside the line "Collatione etiam facta". Running head at top centre, page number at top left.

main_text.p: fa, non necessitate, quæ, si non omnino, saltem aliqua ex parte excusat:sed data o-pera, consulto, improbitate, odio, inui-dia: vel etiam nostra culpa, bonitate, cre-dulitate: quæ omnia ad efficientem & im-pellentem causam referuntur. In finali-bus vero indicandum damnum & detri-mentum, quod nostris infertur opibus, vitæ, famæ, existimationi, quæ etiam vita ipsa charior esse debet. Ex adiunctis porro circumstantiæ petendæ: personarum, loci, temporis, modi, ipsarum rerum, quæ ad amplificandum ponderis momentiq; plurimum habere videntur: atq; planum faciendum: offendi lædiq; eos, quorum chara & accepta esse salus atque incolu-mitas debeat: & lædi ab iis, de quibus multis nominibus bene sint præclareq; meriti: & lædi eo potissimum tempore, quo varia atque magna immineant pericula: amicorum maximè præsidia requirantur: & lædi loco eo, quo minimè coueniebat: & lædi nõ vulgariter, sed nouo quodam, & raro, & inusitato contumeliæ genere. Argumenta [illegible, ~8 letters] entia.Collatione etiam facta, & allatis aliorum iudiciis, aut rumoribꝰ sparsis illud ipsum, quo de querela instituitur, exaggerandū. Motus autem hisce in Epistolis denomi-nantur

page.notes: The left marginal note is partly illegible: the first line after "Argumenta" is Greek and could not be read. The last line of the page, "nantur", is set indented as the end of "denominantur". The catchword and signature are not printed. The running head is set in small capitals and is given here in capitals. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. The word "excusat:sed" is printed without a space after the colon and is copied as printed.
